_README: Copy this file, edit it, then run:
Validate first. It decodes a few frames, checks the pose stream is physically
plausible, and prints which analyses your dataset supports. A sequence with no
poses is still fully usable for the image-only work (crop features, isotropy,
kind = 'folder' for local images, 'huggingface' for an HF dataset.
Delete the keys you do not need; '_'-prefixed keys are ignored.
name: my_dataset

poses._kind_options: tum | csv  — omit the whole 'poses' block if you have none
poses._axes: Which two of xyz form the floor plane. Robot data is usually 'xy'; ICL-NUIM's living room is 'xz'.
poses._rescale_time: Folder frame times are synthesised from fps. If the pose clock spans a different duration, rescale frame times onto it (default true).
